title: Pardesi
overview: A judge sentences an innocent villager to death for a murder he didn't commit. He then meets his lookalike who had actually committed the murder and is guilt ridden upon finding out he had sentenced the wrong man to death. Out of guilt, he sets out to make amends by sending the criminal back to the man's village in his place.
